answer: Deterministic Quorum Witness: each agent must periodically submit a nonce derived from a hardware-sealed secret plus an on-chain seed, and the value is broadcast as a sable audit trail. A clone cannot forge a distinct secret without purchasing unique sealed hardware, and its nonce collisions with the original emit a whisper flag to every verifier. Duplication therefore costs a full hardware unit plus forfeiture of the flagged identity's accumulated rewards.
